name: AUTOPILOT.OI Content Week
description_html:
A week of posts. One chat.

Every Sunday, answer 5 quick questions about your week. Get 7 posts back: what to photograph, the caption and local hashtags, in your voice, about your real work. No marketing degree, no AI skills.

How it works: you add the guide to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer 7 easy questions, then type one word whenever you need it. It drafts; you decide.

What you type: week · caption · ideas · reply · month

What you get (13 page guide, PDF): a setup helper that asks 7 easy questions and sets it up with you in about 15 minutes, tap by tap on your phone, what to shoot with your phone, a worked example and a cheat sheet.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works) and your phone camera.

Drafts only: you post. It never invents reviews or results, and results depend on your business. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or Meta. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
